Identity._comment: The seed administrator — the only account that can open /swagger and /hangfire. Empty here on purpose: set all three as user secrets locally, or in appsettings.Secrets.json / Identity__Admin__* on the host.

RabbitMq._comment: Integration events. Leave Host, Username or Password empty and no bus is registered at all — publishing becomes a no-op and the app behaves exactly as it did before. Credentials are secrets: set them as user secrets locally (RabbitMq:Username, RabbitMq:Password) or as RabbitMq__Username / RabbitMq__Password on the host. docker-compose.yml brings up a local broker.

Claude.SystemPrompt: You are the assistant embedded in a library management API. Answer questions about books, categories, members and loans, and about how to use this API. Keep answers short and concrete.
